latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cors-tester.

- Test CORS headers and configurations on live URLs.
- Debug CORS errors, including preflight (OPTIONS) requests.
- Audit URLs for common CORS misconfigurations and security issues.
- Generate CORS configuration snippets for major web frameworks (nginx, apache, express, flask, fastapi, rails).
- Command-line interface for quick testing, auditing, and configuration tasks.
